relevant

_Second 
Section) 
必須先經過第一階段校內申請通過，且經過國際處向姐妹校提名後，才有資格進行第
二階段(姊妹校)申請。 
申請相關說明/資訊:  
https://www.tha.de/en/International/Exchange-Students/Application-and-arrival.html 
線上申請連結: https://mobility-online.hs-augsburg.de/mobility/login 
▲繳交資料: 
1. Online Application Form* (請點此處填寫表單) 
2. Passport/identity photo(no stamps and marks, max. 500x500 pxls) 
3. Learning Agreement (non-eramus) 
4. CV in English or German (for the students of the Faculty of Design with a link to the 
portfolio) 
5. Transcript of records 
6. Copy of your national ID-card or passport (both sides), as well as residency permit (if 
necessary) 
7. Valid health insurance**
